title: CHROMATIC DIRECTIONALITY — green = sphere∪cube from the fold. red/blue = σ / log. violet bends. brown is DOWN.

do_not_reinvent.green_engine: particle_model proton services — green_engine active on the membrane

thesis: YES. chromatic directionality. color is not decoration — it is a directional basis on the fold. green seats the forms (sphere + cube) as seen FROM the fold. red and blue are the two growth transforms (sigmoid and logarithm). violet is the bend. brown is DOWN.

green.already: inner ear / loopback / green null / green_engine

forms.cube: discrete totality — bingo cube / voxel / face lattice
forms.from_the_fold: sphere ∪ cube are the SAME seat when you stand on the Klein fold and look — continuous and discrete as two faces of one green

green.role: SYSTEM seat. stationary phase. identity that sticks while mobile phase (time) carries the other colors through.

blue.direction: into scale / field / outer sky (already #58a6ff outer ear)
blue.read: cool span. how big things fit on one axis.

red_and_blue.together: red σ and blue log are not enemies. they are two directional bases for growth and measure. chromatograph runs both through the column.

violet.role: BENDING — where the spectrum folds. high end of visible. Klein bend. prism tip.
violet.direction: around / through the fold — not along red or blue, but the curve that joins them when the surface twists
violet.yes: violet bending. the chromatograph's last visible peak before white flake / ultraviolet leave the eye.

brown.why: brown is not a spectral rainbow line — it is earth / compost / soil / gravity costume. off-prism. the direction the fold sits ON.
